STEP 3 evidence: removed ONLY stale bookkeeping annotation crossplane.io/external-create-pending (kubectl annotate bucket buzz-media crossplane.io/external-create-pending- ; rc=0; cluster-scoped MR, ns null). Annotations now: tracking-id, external-create-failed, external-create-succeeded, external-name — untouched. THEN JAM: >20 min no reconcile of buzz-media. Evidence of wedge: (1) provider-gcp-storage logs (pod provider-gcp-storage-f2e4c6b4c94c-74b4b6579c-bp2tj, dell01, up 4d21h): ZERO lines mentioning buzz in 24h despite ReconcileError status; (2) sibling bucket board-games-assets same GVK reconciled 2026-09-06T02:15:19Z (~15 min ago) -> GVK controller healthy, per-key worker wedged; (3) all enqueue paths (annotation edit 23:15 local, ArgoCD sync#3 serverside-apply, periodic resync) produced no reconcile; MR status message still the pre-removal 'cannot determine creation result'. ArgoCD app crossplane-gcp OutOfSync/Degraded op Running Attempt#3 'waiting for healthy state of ServiceAccount/billing-exporter-sa and 73 more resources' (buzz-media among them). Per billing-killswitch skill playbook B (stale-healthy provider, documented remedy: delete active ProviderRevision; core recreates revision+CRDs+Service; MRs untouched), proceeding to delete providerrevision provider-gcp-storage-f2e4c6b4c94c to kill the wedged worker.

STEP 4 progress + second wedge: Bucket MR buzz-media UNJAMMED after revision delete — GCS bucket gs://syscd-buzz-media-7f64e1e9-1738-45f6-86be-649e5a163451 EXISTS, MR Ready=True/Available, Synced=True/ReconcileSuccess, LastAsyncOperation=True/Success (23:36 local). Buzz probe advanced from 404 NoSuchBucket to 403 AccessDenied: buzz-gcs-sa@syscd-443112 lacks storage.objects.create. Root cause: BucketIAMMember buzz-media-admin (grants roles/storage.objectAdmin to buzz-gcs-sa on the buzz bucket) stuck with IDENTICAL stale bookkeeping external-create-pending=2026-08-16T15:00:26Z and 'cannot determine creation result'. Removed its pending annotation (rc=0, same bookkeeping remediation) BUT this GVK missed the event during the fresh provider pod startup window: no reconcile in 4+ min (conditions message still the pre-removal text; provider log has zero IAMMember lines), and provider runs --poll=1h --sync=1h so next automatic try is ~1h away. Re-applying skill playbook B: delete providerrevision provider-gcp-storage-f2e4c6b4c94c again to force full re-list/reconcile of all storage MRs (all others Ready; re-observe is non-destructive Orphan adoption).

STEP 5 progress: IAM member buzz-media-admin UNJAMMED by second revision delete (fresh informers re-listed) — Ready=True/Available, Synced=True, grant roles/storage.objectAdmin -> serviceAccount:buzz-gcs-sa@syscd-443112 on buzz bucket (23:45 local). Buzz probe now AUTHENTICATES and WRITES: failure advanced 404 NoSuchBucket -> 403 AccessDenied -> 429 SlowDown in probe phase if_match_race round 0 (racer 2/3, per-object mutation rate limit on probe/pointer-<uuid> keys). Both pods CrashLoopBackOff with ~5min backoff, retrying automatically. Hypothesis: GCS applies aggressive per-object rate limits to very young buckets (bucket created 23:36); probe races 32 racers CAS-ing one pointer key. Watching for a passing run as bucket warms; crash backoff keeps retrying. Note: deploy buzz has 2 pods (stalled rollout: old RS pod 5ccfc9584b + new RS pod b57844d5c; UP-TO-DATE=1) — normal surge stall while new pod never went Ready; first Ready pod completes rollout and replaces the other.

STEP 6 evidence (~55min post-link): budget re-check via vmsingle — gcp_billing_cost My Budget=1.76 BRL / amount=500 => 0.35%, no non-synthetic budget near 100%; gcloud billing projects describe syscd-443112 still billingEnabled=true account 000600-2E9369-0C8480. NO kill-switch re-trip. ArgoCD app crossplane-gcp: sync=OutOfSync health=Degraded op Running attempt#5 — error is 'failed to create typed patch object (/github-provider; iam...WorkloadIdentityPoolProvider): .spec.forProvider.oidc: expected list, got &{}' — PRE-EXISTING drift on an unrelated MR (app was OutOfSync/Degraded attempt#3 BEFORE any change of mine); all storage MRs it manages (incl. buzz-media + buzz-media-admin) are now Ready=True serverside-applied. Documenting per task guardrails, not improvising beyond scope. Pods: both still CrashLoopBackOff on 429 SlowDown at A3 gate; GCS young-bucket rate limits are the likely cause (bucket 28min old); continuing to watch.

Coach note: Worker-BillingRelink exited mid-watch (exit 1). Progress preserved: pre-check passed (My Budget 1.64/500 BRL = 0.33%), billing linked to 000600-2E9369-0C8480 (was already re-linked; idempotent re-link run), stale external-create-pending annotation removed. New diagnosis: per-key reconciler for buzz-media wedged in-provider (zero log lines 24h, sibling bucket reconciled 15m ago, no enqueue fires). Continuation worker trying upjet state secret removal first.

RESUMED (Worker-BillingRelink-2, 03:20Z): Coach note diagnosis was STALE — the wedged per-key reconciler was ALREADY cleared by predecessor's revision deletes. Live state verified: (1) Bucket MR buzz-media Ready=True/Synced=True, external-name syscd-buzz-media-7f64e1e9-1738-45f6-86be-649e5a163451, gsutil ls confirms bucket + packs/ + probe/ prefixes exist. (2) BucketIAMMember buzz-media-admin Ready=True/Synced=True (grant roles/storage.objectAdmin -> svc buzz-gcs-sa). (3) Steps 1-3 of continuation brief (upjet state secret hunt/removal) MOOT — no wedged MR exists; deleting a per-key state secret now would force a pointless reconcile of Ready MRs. (4) REAL remaining blocker: buzz pods (both RS pods, same image buzz:0.1.0, env byte-identical to the 24d-old RS that ran fine) crashloop at the A3 git conformance probe: phase if_match_race round 0, racer 2-8 of 32 gets 429 SlowDown on probe/pointer-<uuid> object — per-object mutation rate limit on the then-young bucket (created 23:36 local). Pods retry every ~5min (CrashLoopBackOff ~4-5m), rollout held at 0/1 with maxUnavailable=0 (RS 5ccfc9584b + b57844d5c, deploy 31d old, rollout-restart stacking).

EMPIRICAL UNJAM EVIDENCE (03:31Z, bucket ~55min old): reproduced the probe's exact access pattern — 32 concurrent gsutil puts on ONE fresh object with x-goog-if-generation-match:0 (same CAS semantics, gcloud creds same project): result 1x rc=0 (success) + 31x PreconditionException 412 + ZERO 429 SlowDown => the young-bucket per-object mutation throttle has RELAXED; race pattern is now passable. Old-bucket history corroborates: same image+probe ran 24d on the Aug-13 bucket (tk-zxx zombie pod), so probe passes on warm buckets.

STEP 5 re-checks: gcloud billing projects describe syscd-443112 -> billingEnabled=true, account 000600-2E9369-0C8480. Budget ratio via vmsingle pf(8428): gcp_billing_cost/gcp_billing_amount My Budget = 0.00352 (0.35%) — NO kill-switch re-trip. ArgoCD crossplane-gcp still OutOfSync/Degraded but on the SAME pre-existing unrelated github-provider WorkloadIdentityPoolProvider schema drift (attempt#5, predates task); all storage MRs serverside-applied green. Storage provider: pod 1/1 Running 0 restarts (51m), revision Active/True. Now watching pods for a passing probe run (backoff timers fire every ~5min).

CONTINUATION EVIDENCE (04:06Z, Worker-BillingRelink-2): ROOT CAUSE OF PROBE 429 NAILED DOWN EMPIRICALLY.

1. Replicated the probe's EXACT pattern (SigV4 + HMAC creds from buzz-secrets, XML API, 32 threads barrier-released, same-object PUT): (a) create-CAS via x-goog-if-generation-match:0 / ifGenerationMatch=0 -> 1x200 + 31x412, ZERO 429 (healthy); (b) update-CAS via If-Match:<etag> (what 'if_match_race' actually does) -> 19x200 + 13x429 SlowDown = EXACT reproduction of pod failure. Precondition-rejected writes don't count as mutations, but If-Match updates DO -> 32 simultaneous updates on one fresh object name trip GCS's per-object mutation limiter (quotas doc: 'Maximum rate of writes to the same object name: One write per second' + request-rate doc: fresh key-range burst needs gradual ramp; buckets scale over ~20min doubling).

2. Bucket is young (created 02:36Z); burst capacity is still ramping. Measured 32-wide If-Match race success trend: 17/32 ok (03:55Z) -> 19/32 (04:02Z) -> 22/32 (04:05Z after 24-key spread warm-up in probe/ prefix). Pods keep retrying every ~5min (CrashLoopBackOff) and each attempt itself warms the probe/ range. Probe needs ALL 32 racers clean; waiting for bucket scaling to converge is the sanctioned GCS remedy (docs explicitly prescribe gradual ramp, not config change).

3. Probe-vs-my-tests difference explained: earlier gsutil/JSON tests passed because gsutil serializes and JSON create-CAS precondition-rejects don't count as mutations; the Rust probe fires true simultaneous If-Match updates on one fresh probe/pointer-<uuid> name per boot.

4. During diagnostic testing I wrote only throwaway objects under diag/ and probe/warm-* prefixes using the same creds the probe uses; no probe/pointer-* or app keys touched; no MR/spec changes. diag/ objects can be deleted later (lifecycle or manual) — cosmetic only.

Continuing watch for a zero-429 probe pass as bucket ages (~1.5h old now).

PLATEAU FINDING (05:10Z): 60 min of hourly width-32 If-Match races (04:19-05:09, every 5min, results also warming the range) show success ratio FLAT at 19-22/32 (60-70%) — bucket-age-driven scaling has converged and is NOT sufficient for the probe's 32-wide burst (~20-write burst tolerance per fresh object name). Earlier 'trend' reading was noise. Pod retries still 429 (last: 04:18 racer 3). Width sweep: 8/8 ok at width 8, 14/16 at width 16 => tolerance ~20 in burst window.

ASSESSMENT: the OLD bucket passed this probe while carrying SUSTAINED relay media traffic Aug 13-30; per request-rate docs GCS auto-scaling is load-driven (redistributes after sustained load, ramp guidance: double rate / 20min). New bucket has ~zero traffic outside my sparse burst tests — nothing has triggered range scaling beyond the floor.

REMEDY (docs-sanctioned gradual ramp, no config/spec change): driving SUSTAINED ~40 writes/s rotating-key load under probe/load-* for ~15min to trigger GCS load redistribution, then re-measuring width-32. Load objects are throwaway ~100B; will note cleanup. Pods keep their own 5min retry cadence meanwhile.

FINAL VERDICT + UPSTREAM CONFIRMATION (05:58Z, Worker-BillingRelink-2): THE 429s MASK A STRUCTURAL INCOMPATIBILITY — GCS S3-interop CANNOT PASS THE A3 PROBE, EVER.

Decisive evidence chain:
1. REPRODUCED the probe's exact race (SigV4+HMAC, XML API, If-Match:<etag>, 32 barrier-released racers, one object): consistently 19-23x 200 + 13-17x 429 SlowDown across 60+ minutes of tests (04:00-05:10), incl. after 15min sustained 13.6 wps warm-up load (12,305 writes, 0 err) — burst tolerance FLAT at ~2/3 of instantaneous burst width. No convergence with age or load.
2. CAS SEMANTICS TEST (decisive): sequential PUT with a STALE If-Match etag on GCS S3-interop returns **200, not 412** — GCS's compat layer does NOT enforce S3 conditional writes (same finding as upstream issue). ETag is content-MD5, not a version token. So even without 429s, phase-2/3 of the probe ('expected exactly 1 winner, got N') could never hold on GCS.
3. UPSTREAM CONFIRMS: block/buzz issue #2470 'Git object-store A3 conformance probe fails on GCS S3-interop (if_match_race)' — reporter (Apiary, GKE+GCS): 'GCS's S3-interoperability layer does not honor If-Match/If-None-Match preconditions on PUT... makes git-on-object-storage unusable on GCS for any deployer using the documented S3 configuration.' Maintainer response: 'Fixed in #2511 — clearer A3 failure text and Helm git.conformanceProbe for skipping on non-CAS backends (e.g. GCS)' — but PR #2511 is still OPEN (not merged, not in any chart/tag); chart 0.1.7/0.1.8 have NO conformance knob. Upstream's own workaround: BUZZ_GIT_CONFORMANCE_PROBE=false + 'quarantine git features operationally — an availability workaround, not a solution.'
4. METRICS REFUTATION of 'probe passed for 24d': vmsingle kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{pod=buzz-8c8564b85-7m8ph} went 5108 (Aug 5) -> 7007 (Sep 5) — ~1900 restarts/31d = crashloop every ~5min the ENTIRE time. The A3 probe NEVER passed on the old bucket either; the relay has never successfully served. tk-zxx's 'probe passed against the previous bucket' was an inference, not a fact.

CONCLUSION: All bucket-level goals of tk-xfv are COMPLETE (billing re-linked 000600-2E9369-0C8480, no kill-switch re-trip, budget 0.35%, Bucket+IAMMember MRs Ready=True, GCS bucket exists, buzz pods now reach GCS with valid auth and write). The pod crashloop is NOT a bucket/billing defect: buzz 0.1.0's fail-closed A3 gate is unsatisfiable on GCS by design. REMAINING REMEDIES (all require user decision — deployment/chart/spec changes are outside this task's guardrails):
(a) set BUZZ_GIT_CONFORMANCE_PROBE=false in buzz deployment env (upstream-sanctioned availability workaround; git-object-store features then lack CAS protection on GCS) — 1-line valuesObject change, e.g. extraEnv in the chart — needs Yuri's approval + commit to GitOps repo (chart 0.1.7 deployment supports extra env? verify; else chart bump to a version with git.conformanceProbe after PR #2511 merges);
(b) or wait for upstream: PR #2511 merge (helm knob) / native GCS backend (#2470 option 1);
(c) or move git store to a CAS-capable backend (MinIO/R2) keeping media on GCS.
Cleanup: all ~12.4k diagnostic objects I created (probe/load-*, probe/warm-*, diag/*, failed pointer residue incl. 91 stale probe/pointer-*) deleted; bucket now contains only packs/ + empty probe/ prefix. No MR/spec/budget touch. Flags for review: ready-to-review with the structural blocker documented; the task's 'buzz pod Ready' criterion is UNACHIEVABLE within current guardrails (needs the user decision above).

APPROVED: independent live-state validation by Validator-xfv (all six checks re-run fresh 06:20–06:25Z, READ-ONLY; no browser screenshots — live-ops validation with no UI surface, the relay is down by the very failure under review; evidence is command output). 1. BILLING ✓ — gcloud billing projects describe syscd-443112 → billingEnabled=true, billingAccountName=billingAccounts/000600-2E9369-0C8480. 2. CROSSPLANE MRs ✓ — bucket buzz-media (cluster-scoped storage.gcp.upbound.io): Ready=True, Synced=True (ReconcileSuccess), LastAsyncOperation=True/Success, external-name=syscd-buzz-media-7f64e1e9-1738-45f6-86be-649e5a163451. BucketIAMMember buzz-media-admin: Ready=True, Synced=True (ReconcileSuccess), role roles/storage.objectAdmin → serviceAccount:buzz-gcs-sa@syscd-443112.iam.gserviceaccount.com on the buzz bucket (external-name confirms binding to that bucket). 3. GCS BUCKET ✓ — gs://syscd-buzz-media-7f64e1e9-1738-45f6-86be-649e5a163451 exists; 285 objects total, only prefixes packs/ (279 objects, app-written, timestamps 02:52–04:32Z) + probe/. ZERO diag/, warm-*, load-* or stale-pointer residue from the worker's testing. Note: 2 probe/pointer-* objects exist NOW (06:15:59Z, 06:18:34Z) — these post-date the 05:58Z cleanup and are app-created, not residue: pointer-783d0b46… is byte-identical to the key in the pod's 06:18 probe failure log. The app itself writes them each retry; 'probe/ empty' was true at cleanup time. 4. PODS ✓ — both RS pods (buzz-5ccfc9584b-k54m2, buzz-b57844d5c-78wvb) CrashLoopBackOff 0/1 (68 restarts/5h18m and 29/123m ≈ 5min cadence as documented). Previous-run logs of BOTH pods end identically: A3 conformance probe fails in phase 'if_match_race' (round 0) with s3 backend HTTP 429 SlowDown 'exceeded the rate limit for object mutation operations (create, update, and delete)' + gcs429 docs link, naming per-object probe/pointer- keys — the exact GCS per-object mutation limiter story in the FINAL VERDICT. No 404/403 anywhere; auth + object create succeed (280 packs + pointers written prove the full write path). 5. BUDGET ✓ — vmsingle (pf 8428) last_over_time 24h: only non-synthetic series My Budget cost=2.52 BRL / amount=500 → 0.50% (up from worker's 0.35% reading, still 200x below trip). NO kill-switch re-trip. 6. UPSTREAM ✓ — block/buzz #2470 open: title matches exactly ('Git object-store A3 conformance probe fails on GCS S3-interop (if_match_race)'), repro is GKE + GCS S3-interop XML API (vsima). Acknowledgment present (Chessing234, author_association=CONTRIBUTOR — upstream-recognized, though literally CONTRIBUTOR not MEMBER): 'Fixed in #2511 — clearer A3 failure text and Helm git.conformanceProbe for skipping on non-CAS backends (e.g. GCS)'. PR #2511 verified OPEN and UNMERGED (state=open, merged=false, base main, updated 2026-09-01) → no chart knob available today. JUDGMENT: every objective achievable within the task's guardrails is verified achieved (billing re-linked, no re-trip, Bucket+IAMMember green, bucket live with real app data, pods reach GCS with valid auth and write). The one open criterion — buzz pod Ready — is documented as structurally unsatisfiable: buzz 0.1.0's fail-closed A3 gate cannot pass on GCS S3-interop (per-object 429 mutation limiter + no If-Match CAS enforcement), corroborated by upstream #2470 and an unmerged #2511. The remedy (BUZZ_GIT_CONFORMANCE_PROBE=false values change | chart bump after #2511 merges | CAS-capable git backend like MinIO/R2) is a deployment/chart/spec decision explicitly outside this task's guardrails → routed to the user via Coach. Approving on achieved-objectives + precise structural-blocker handoff.
